# Brad Lasater

> Applied scientist and machine-learning engineer with ten years of production
> ML, optimization, and state-estimation work across consumer marketplaces,
> live events, aerospace, and defense — now building an end-to-end systematic
> volatility trading system from scratch and documenting it in public,
> including the parts that do not work. Based in the United States, seeking
> quantitative research and quantitative engineering roles in New York.

Brad Lasater holds U.S. Patent 10,204,323, was previously cleared TS/SCI, and
served as a Sergeant and instructor in the United States Marine Corps before
his technical career. He holds an M.Eng. in Systems Engineering from Arizona
State University and a B.S. in Applied Mathematics from the University of Texas
at Arlington.

The volatility system is built on Euan Sinclair's work on the mechanics and
economics of volatility trading, and Marcos López de Prado's work on the
statistics of not fooling yourself. Its distinguishing feature is not the
returns — which may not exist — but the research process: an evaluation
protocol fixed in public before any results were produced, deflated Sharpe
ratios reported next to raw ones, execution costs modelled rather than assumed
away, and an append-only live track record whose dates are enforced by CI
rather than asserted.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://bradlasater.com/): Who Brad Lasater is, selected experience at Nift, Ticketmaster, Lockheed Martin, and Boeing, and the through-line connecting them — decision-making under uncertainty.
- [The volatility system](https://bradlasater.com/vol/): The full architecture, stage by stage — data ingestion and cleaning, arbitrage-free surface construction, volatility forecasting, signal and sizing, risk and hedging, execution, evaluation, and operations.
- [Evaluation protocol](https://bradlasater.com/vol/methodology.html): The pre-committed rules for judging the system — purged and embargoed cross-validation, mandatory baselines that must be beaten, cost and friction modelling, deflated performance statistics, and kill criteria fixed in advance.
- [Live track record](https://bradlasater.com/vol/track-record.html): Append-only out-of-sample results. Every observation is a separate dated commit; CI rejects any edit to published history; every statistic is recomputed in the browser from the raw data.
- [Research log](https://bradlasater.com/log/): Dated entries on what was tried, what was expected, what happened, and what was wrong. Negative results are entries too.
- [Curriculum vitae](https://bradlasater.com/cv.html): Full professional history including military and teaching service, education, patents, and technologies.

## Data

- [Track record raw data](https://bradlasater.com/data/track-record.json): The machine-readable source behind every published performance statistic.
- [Track record schema](https://github.com/bradlasater/bradlasater.github.io/blob/main/data/SCHEMA.md): Field definitions and the immutability rules enforced on the data.
